name: Velvet Grit
north_star: 90s R&B harmony warmth, classic freestyle urgency, intimate modern alt-R&B phrasing, and playful rap-sung confidence — all resolved through Luzaria's own locked mathematical voice.
identity_rule: Every lead, double, harmony, whisper, ad-lib, and rap-sung layer is rendered from the same Luzaria voice profile. Pitch, timing, breath, intensity, and articulation may change; formant identity and artist identity may not.

lead_chain.register: warm smoky alto with approved upper extension
lead_chain.delivery: close-mic, breath-led, emotionally direct, conversational until the declaration lines
lead_chain.timing: 8 to 22 milliseconds behind the instrumental pocket
lead_chain.dynamic_arc: soft spoken onset to chest-supported declaration to controlled upper lift
processing: low-feedback eighth-note delay on phrase tails
parallel grit bus below the lead

components: low smoky double at minus 3 semitones, minus 10 dB, 18 milliseconds late
verse.rule: Keep the verse intimate; harmony should feel discovered, not announced.

pre_chorus.rule: Harmony blooms only after the emotional premise is clear.

components: airy octave accent on the final phrase
chorus.rule: Lush, warm, and emotionally stacked; never choir-like and never a collection of different personas.

freestyle_hook.timing: answers land between drum-machine claps and syncopated bass hits
freestyle_hook.rule: Use classic freestyle urgency without sounding like a museum recreation.

bridge.rule: The bridge strips the arrangement back and makes the voice feel dangerously close.

traits: lead identity preserved across every layer

modern_alt_rnb_pocket.purpose: private confession and unpredictable emotional phrasing

traits: quick return to full sung tone

soul_funk_upper_lift.purpose: fearless declaration and controlled high-register release

old_school_elements: bright but slightly detuned synth stabs
modernization_rules: sub-bass extends below the classic electro bass
drums use modern transient control and negative space
lead vocal stays dry and intimate rather than arena-sized
verses use current alt-R&B broken phrasing
one rap-sung switch may appear without changing persona
mix preserves analog warmth while meeting current loudness and low-end expectations

sleep_on_the_floor_application.declaration_1: soul_funk_upper_lift with a short velvet_90s_harmony bloom
sleep_on_the_floor_application.verse_2: testimony_grit with one freestyle_electro_lift pulse beneath the line endings
sleep_on_the_floor_application.final_declaration: soul_funk_upper_lift, five-layer chorus stack, then a dry playful_rap_sung_switch echo on the final refusal
sleep_on_the_floor_application.rule: Freestyle elements support survival momentum; they must not turn the testimony into a dance novelty.
